common_mode_specification.spatial_scope: Lot-synchronous (applied identically to all L=20 components in each lot; independent across lots)

epistemic_limitation_statement: Null C is an out-of-distribution common-mode stress test evaluating robustness against synchronous lot-wide thermal perturbations (+5C at 72h and 96h). The detector was calibrated on Null A (IID stationary noise without common-mode disturbance). Null C results must NEVER be pooled with Null A or Null B and must NEVER be used for threshold tuning or recalibration. Results reflect synthetic-model performance and must NOT be interpreted as claims about real ATE/chamber telemetry without empirical chamber qualification.
